geometry.note: No sourced length exists for this specific 400 MeV Linac (only its energy is sourced), so no length check is possible and confidence stays approximate.

method: Straight line from 15% beyond the OSM 'Linac Gallery' (way 272646258) footprint centroid, through that centroid, through the OSM 'LINAC-II' (way 1316753870) footprint centroid, to 15% beyond it -- approximating the beam axis along the two buildings that house the linac. Not a trace of the accelerator itself (OSM has no beamline way for it).
name: Fermilab Linac (approximate axis)

summary.plain: An approximate line along the buildings that house the 400 MeV Linac (OpenStreetMap 'Linac Gallery' and 'LINAC-II'); no source gives the Linac's length, so the line is not checked against one.
